== Project info ==

Welcome to the OAC replacement addon page.<br>

This page is part of the [[OAC:Project|OAC project]].

To further enhance the experience the OAC releases replacement addons from time to time. <br>
This page is meant to give an overview about the available replacements.<br>

''Definition''

A replacement addon is using some 3rd party addon to replace the look of a different unit. <br>
At times the sound and gameplay related aspects are replaced as well.<br>

== Installation ==

=== Preface ===

NEVER ever put addons (pbo files) in the ArmA\addons folder!

You can only have one replacement addon active for a specific unit at a time.<br>
In other words a T72 tank can only have one model at a time. Sounds logical.

You can understand what unit is replaced by looking at the naming of the pbo.

 OAC_R_'''AH64'''_MAP_Air

OAC is the addon tag. The R tag stands for replacement file. '''AH64 means the unit.'''<br>
So the part after OAC describes the unit.<br>
The rest is the addon (pbo name) the replacement is based on.

=== Instructions ===

1. You need to download both the replacement addon(s) and the OAC replacement addon(s)<br>
via the OAC YomaTools server.<br>
Refer to the [[OAC:DownloadAndPlay|Download and play]] guide on the OAC project BIKI page.<br>

2. To be able to get the replacement addon working you need to download the<br>
required addon the replacement is based on.<br>
You find a list of the available replacement addons and their required addons
below.

3. Move the desired replacement addon from #notInUse to one level higher.

 .\ArmA\addons\x\oac_replacements\addons\#notInUse\OAC_R_AH64_MAP_Air.pbo

to

 .\ArmA\addons\x\oac_replacements\addons\OAC_R_AH64_MAP_Air.pbo

4. Once you have downloaded the required addon(s), put the PBO(s) in the 
 .\ArmA\addons\x\oac_replacements\addons
folder and load the modfolder as well.

=== HTTP download ===

You can download the replacement addons via HTTP as well.<br>

HTTP URL:

 http://oac.quest-link.net/yas/oac/x/oac/oac_replacements_units/addons/%23notInUse/

P85 replacements - HTTP URL:

 http://oac.quest-link.net/yas/oac/x/oac/oac_replacements_p85/addons/%23notInUse/

=== Replacements without OAC ===

Most replacement addons are based standard arma classes and can be used for<br>
regular arma missions as well.

Download the replacements via the HTTP download from above, get the <br>
{{Link|link= http://dev-heaven.net/projects/list_files/oac|text= ofp_compatibility_addon.7z}} and the needed base addons in addition to each replacement<br>
and load them via modfolders.


For people with basic config or logic understanding, the replacements made<br>
for OFP classes are very simple to update to similar arma classes, <br>
like AH64 to AH1W.<br>
Most times its only removing one level of inheritance or renaming the classes basically.
